sloka: न द्विजातिर् अहम् राजन् मा भूत् ते मनसो व्यथा ।शूद्रायाम् अस्मि वैश्येन जातः जन पद अधिप ॥२-६३-५३॥
transliteration: na dvijātir aham rājan mā bhūt te manaso vyathā ।śūdrāyām asmi vaiśyena jātaḥ jana pada adhipa ॥2-63-53॥

translations.english: 'O king Dasaratha, lord of the land, I am not a brahmin. Feel no sense of guilt in your mind. I was born of a sudra mother and a vaisya father.
